question:

more beautiful
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "most beautiful"


Explanation:

☛ "Beautiful one" is incorrect because it doesn’t convey the superlative sense (being the best in the group) required here.

Grammar Rules:

☛ Superlative Degree is used when comparing one item to three or more items (e.g., "the smartest student in the class").
☛ Context Clues: Words like "contest," "award," or "competition" often signal the need for a superlative adjective.
☛ Avoid Errors: Never use the positive degree where a comparative/superlative is logically required (e.g., "He is tall" → Incorrect if comparing in a group).

Grammar Rules:

Read the following sentence and select its future tense form from the options given below:
Ramya finished her dissertation early.
options_hi: Ramya will finish her dissertation early.
Ramya had finished her dissertation early.
Ramya has finished her dissertation early.
Ramya is finishing her dissertation early.
solution_hi:
Solution: Correct Answer is "Ramya will finish her dissertation early."


Explanation:
☛ मूल वाक्य "Ramya finished her dissertation early." past tense में है, जो कि एक completed action को दर्शाता है।
☛ Question में future tense form पूछा गया है, इसलिए 'will' का use करके future tense बनाया गया है।
☛ "Will finish" future simple tense का सही structure है, जो कि एक upcoming action को indicate करता है।
☛ अन्य options में - 'had finished' (past perfect), 'has finished' (present perfect), और 'is finishing' (present continuous) हैं, जो future tense नहीं हैं।
☛ यह वाक्य grammatically accurate है और natural flow के साथ future action को express करता है।


Grammar Rules:
☛ Future Simple Tense: Subject + will/shall + V1 + object (e.g., "She will call tomorrow").
☛ Tense Identification: हमेशा question में पूछे गए tense को ध्यान से पहचानें (past/present/future)।
☛ Auxiliary Verbs: Future tense में 'will' का use होता है, 'shall' का use modern English में कम common है।
☛ Common Errors: 'Will be finishing' (future continuous) भी correct हो सकता है, लेकिन यहाँ simple future ही option में दिया गया है।
